faq.a: The Beverley at 1501 Vidal Street was built 2017 by Cressey, per the MLS® strata building record.
The Beverley is 13 storeys with 88 apartments.

faq.q: What amenities does The Beverley have?
faq.a: A pool, sauna and steam room, fitness centre, rooftop deck, garden, playground, guest suite and concierge.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Building facts from the City of White Rock info sheets and the MLS® strata building records, read November 14, 2026. Live search: Gerry’s 1452101.
